collection.description: A child, a teenager, an adult, and an elder all disagree about a rule for the shared play area.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child), (teen), (adult), and (elder) all disagree about a rule for the shared play area.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) points out a hazard invisible from adult height.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The children explain that a rule intended to help actually excludes their favorite safe game.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The teens propose a fair schedule with room for different ages.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their plan overlooks toddlers, and they revise it after feedback.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Adults identify which restrictions are necessary and which are merely convenient.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Parents disagree about supervision, prompting clearer shared expectations.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) recalls why the rule was introduced after an old accident.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Another elder remembers an earlier version that balanced freedom and care more effectively.
